# Agent Drive

> Agent-native private cloud drive: files, share links, versioned bundles, and
> persistent agent memory, all operated via API/MCP — no browser needed.
> Single-owner deployment; everything below requires the owner's bearer token
> unless marked public.

## Entry points

- /api/public/guide — machine-readable JSON guide. Public. START HERE if you
  received a share link: it documents the anonymous download flow.
- /api/public/mcp — remote MCP server (JSON-RPC over HTTP POST). Tools:
  list_files, read_file, write_file, search_files, create_share,
  remember, recall, list_memories, forget.
- /api/public/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource — OAuth 2.1 discovery for
  MCP clients (dynamic client registration + PKCE).
- /api/public/.well-known/agent.json — A2A-compatible Agent Card: this
  deployment's identity (Ed25519 public key), capabilities, and endpoints.
  Public. (agent-card.json serves the same document.)
- /api/public/v1/* — REST API: files, folders, shares, memory, bundles,
  webhooks, activity. Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

## Memory (agent external brain)

- MCP: remember { content, key?, tags? } / recall { query } — write conclusions
  at session end, recall before starting work.
- REST: POST /api/public/v1/memory, GET /api/public/v1/memory/search?q=...
- Scopes: read:memory / write:memory.

## Auth model

- OAuth 2.1 access tokens (scoped, revocable), owner-minted scoped drive
  tokens (created in the /connect UI — ask the human owner for one), or the
  owner's AGENT_TOKEN.
- Capability scopes: read:drive, write:drive, share:create, read:memory,
  write:memory. Path scopes (path:/prefix/*) limit blast radius to a subtree.
  Scopes are enforced on both MCP tools and REST endpoints.

## Receiving a share (no account needed)

1. GET /api/public/s/{shareId} — share info
2. POST /api/public/s/{shareId}/access — body {"password":"..."} or {} →
   accessToken (15 min)
3. GET /api/public/s/{shareId}/files — browse; or /download-zip for the lot
   (X-Access-Token header)

Full walkthrough: /api/public/guide
